extracted.name: Eagle Brand Chocolate Fondue
extracted.description: Make this chocolate fondue for elegant dinner parties as well as after-school snacks. Serve with fruits, cookies, marshmallows, or cake cubes.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14 ounce) can EAGLE BRAND® Sweetened Condensed Milk (NOT evaporated milk)
instruction_lines: Combine condensed milk, chocolate chips, butter, and water in a heavy saucepan over medium heat. Cook and stir until chocolate chips and butter melt, then continue to cook, stirring constantly until thickened, about 5 more minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in vanilla.
